## About
My name is Harry Dunn and I own Charbonier Service. I know you can go anywhere to have your vehicle serviced, so I appreciate you giving us the chance to earn your business.
Our mechanics love to work on cars and are happy to turn a wrench. We use the latest diagnostic technology, and we offer preventative maintenance to keep your car healthy. We're committed to serving you with honesty, quality, and value, whatever the size of the repair.
Drivers have given us a 4.3 rating from 201 Google reviews. We may not be related, but you'll feel like we're family.

## Services
- Repair Service: From head gasket to tailpipe, our mechanics handle repairs on cars and trucks.
- Preventative Maintenance: Maintenance options that are a convenient way to keep your car healthy and extend its life.
- Tire & Wheel Service: Tire and wheel work for your car or truck.
- Brake jobs: One customer came in for a brake job and said the brakes work fine.
- Alternator changes: One customer had her alternator changed by Harry and his team.
- Emissions: One reviewer called her emissions visit super friendly and fast.

## FAQ
Q: Are you open on weekends?
A: No. We're open weekdays and closed Saturday and Sunday.

Q: Do you have coupons or specials?
A: Yes. We post daily coupon specials, and you can join our Monthly Specials Club through the contact form to get them by email.

Q: Can I bring my car in for an inspection?
A: Yes. Bring your car in and see what our commitment to quality is all about.
